summary_md: **Ying Yao ([@YingYaoShakewin](https://x.com/YingYaoShakewin/status/2115476274735132874))** built **Tadpole**, an LLM agent from scratch in ~3,500 lines of Python, then post-trained Qwen3-4B behind it with SFT, expert iteration and GRPO; it runs 24/7 on Telegram, and the repo shares code, adapters, data and failures.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - shakewingo/Tadpole: Build an LLM agent from scratch and continuously evolve it.

relevance: An end-to-end small-model agent plus post-training recipe that is fully open.
